summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new Baseline Versioning UI feature. All backend endpoints and frontend UI components are working correctly. The feature allows users to view all baseline versions in a timeline, see which version is active, and restore any previous version with one click. Recalibration correctly creates new incrementing versions.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/product-lines/{id}/baseline-versions returns correct structure with active_version and versions array
Backend: POST /api/product-lines/{id}/baseline-versions/{version}/activate successfully restores previous versions
Backend: Version activation correctly updates active flags and baseline_version field
Frontend: Versions tab (data-testid='tab-versions') renders and is accessible
Frontend: Versions timeline list (data-testid='baseline-versions-list') displays correctly
Frontend: Version rows (data-testid='version-row-{n}') render for each version
Frontend: Active version shows 'Active' badge and disabled 'In use' button
Frontend: Archived versions show 'Archived' badge and enabled 'Restore' button (data-testid='restore-version-{n}')
Frontend: Clicking Restore on archived version triggers API call and shows success toast
Frontend: After restore, version list refreshes with correct Active/Archived states
Frontend: Line header badge updates to show 'Calibrated v{restored_version}'
Frontend: Recalibrating via 'Use demo sample parts' button creates new incrementing version
Frontend: New version becomes active after calibration
Frontend: Tab switching between Calibration/Inspect/Versions/History/Insights works correctly without flicker or reverting
